verdicts.flaw_description: The purchase counts "cover the sessions that signed in, and a quarter of each segment never signed in", so the measured population is a quarter narrower than the claim's population and the checkout page itself could change who signs in. (The site-wide discount is neutralized, since "every segment browsed a fixed-price contract catalogue".)

The particulate figures "cover the scheduled runs that returned a reading", yet "a quarter of scheduled runs at each stack returned no reading", so the 8-14 percent reductions are computed on a self-selected 75 percent of runs rather than on the stack's actual output. Throughput is genuinely controlled ("matched the earlier quarter within a percent"), so coverage is the live defect.

The abduction averages "cover the patients who were reassessed at the follow-up clinic" while "a quarter of each intake missed the follow-up clinic", so the 9-16 degree gains describe only the three-quarters who returned, and poor responders are exactly the ones likeliest to be missing. The corticosteroid confound is ruled out because "every intake was medically barred from receiving them".

Germination "rates cover the trays that reached the scoring date" but "about a fifth of each lot's trays went unscored", so the 6-11 point improvements are measured on a narrower set of trays than the lot, and dropped trays plausibly differ in germination. House temperature is genuinely held constant ("matched the earlier sowing to a tenth of a degree"), so the coverage gap is the live problem.
